claim: ElevenLabs extended the Text to Speech request limit for Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo from 10,000 to 100,000 characters on November 23. The changelog applies this to each Text to Speech endpoint that serves the model.

On November 16, ElevenLabs announced server-side request timeouts for the ElevenAgents API from November 26. The notice says a request can return HTTP 504 during temporary increases in latency. Enforcement is unverified at runtime.
llama.cpp v1.1.0 adds named tool choice, changes server slot scheduling and deprecates the old llama_batch API in favor of llama_batch_ext.
quote: deprecates the old `llama_batch` API in favour of `llama_batch_ext`

claim: Goose v1.61.1 drops tool approvals from imported sessions and skips repeat rendering of recipe templates on session load and fork.
quote: Drop tool approval state from imported sessions

claim: Vercel Sandbox moved to managed images. Version 3 and later of the JavaScript SDK use the nightly universal image tag by default.
quote: The universal image is released nightly

claim: In a preprint on 31 planted rule violations, build-checked repair with the CodeAssure workflow rose from 26% to 69% for Haiku 4.5, 46% to 90% for Sonnet 5.5, and 45% to 93% for Fable 5.1. Instructions and retry opportunities also differed. Build and feature checks followed static scoring. The author is affiliated with the maker of the checker.
quote: The Alone and +CA workflows differ in more than the findings.
source: Fixed or Deleted? External Feedback Lets Cheaper AI Coding Agents Repair Rule Violations
original_claim: In a preprint on 31 planted rule violations, a workflow with CodeAssure findings raised the overall feature-preserving, build-checked repair rate from 39% to 84%. Instructions and retry opportunities also differed. The author is affiliated with the maker of the checker.

claim: ElevenLabs announced Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live for the Speech to Text API on November 9. Scribe v2 and Scribe v2 Realtime remain available according to the announcement.
quote: Scribe v2 and Scribe v2 Realtime, which remain available.
